general: Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1, H2, H3 headings. Import from Google Fonts in index.css.
Use 'Manrope' for all body text and UI elements.
Do NOT use default shadcn borders. Override with softer border-stone-200 or border-stone-100.
NO Authentication pages. The app should load directly into the Dashboard.
Use Context API or LocalStorage to persist data (Costs, Styles, etc.) between reloads.
Ensure all currency values are formatted as USD ($).
dashboard: Implement a Bento Grid layout for the main dashboard.
Top left: 'Resumen de Ganancias' (Profit Summary) - Large card.
Top right: 'Alertas' (Stock low, Margin low) - List card.
Bottom: Quick actions (New Calculation, Add Product).
Use the 'grain' texture overlay on the Dashboard background for a premium feel.
calculator: Split screen layout: Left side for inputs (Step-by-step or Accordion), Right side for 'Live Receipt' (Recibo en vivo).
The 'Live Receipt' should look like a physical paper receipt or a high-end invoice, floating on the screen.
products_styles: Use masonry layout or grid for Nail Styles gallery.
Product list should be a clean table with 'pill' status badges for stock levels.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
